rule.name: ForwardDropsParameter
rule.message: This override never reads one of its parameters and only forwards the call to a same-named method without it, so the value passed by the caller is silently lost. Pass the parameter on (return delegate.send(message, headers, timeout);), or call the overload that really takes it. An exception fits when the value does not apply to this class: say so with a throw, or keep the unused parameter out of the forwarded call on purpose in a documented adapter.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName = 'Override']] [let $call := Block[count(*) = 1]/(ReturnStatement | ExpressionStatement)/MethodCall, $method := ., $names := FormalParameters/FormalParameter/VariableId/@Name, $unused := FormalParameters/FormalParameter[not(@Varargs = true())]/VariableId[not(@Name = $call//VariableAccess/@Name)] return exists($call) and exists($unused) and $call/@MethodName = @Name and not($call/TypeArguments) and (exists($call/*[1][self::SuperExpression]) or (let $supers := ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration][1] /(ExtendsList | ImplementsList)/ClassType/@SimpleName, $recv := $call/*[1][self::VariableAccess[not(@Name = $names)] or self::FieldAccess[*[1][self::ThisExpression[not(*)]]]] return exists($recv) and (some $f in ancestor::ClassBody[1]/FieldDeclaration[ClassType/@SimpleName = $supers] /VariableDeclarator/VariableId satisfies $f/@Name = $recv/@Name))) and $call/ArgumentList/@Size >= 1 and $call/ArgumentList/@Size < count($names) and (every $a in $call/ArgumentList/* satisfies $a[self::VariableAccess][@Name = $names])]
